scientific_contract.hypothesis: The implemented phase-selective stock/proxy KV consumer can execute through the pinned full Gemma target-verification path, remain exact at stock boundaries, and retain positive net target-cycle savings after all shadow maintenance costs.
scientific_contract.workload_and_quality_gates: Use the exact workload, exactness gates, cache-lifecycle gates, economic denominator, and conditional endpoint gate from the scientific binding without amendment.

failure_sequence: The r4 launch reached the pinned production consumer and showed that prepare_for_verify was not its ABI.
The r5 launch completed model load and CUDA graphs, then showed that class-level NgramVerifyInput.verify was not its ABI.
Both failures occurred before candidate CUDA or any scientific sample.
decision_evidence.material_change: Do not infer or stage another method name. Before claiming the GPU, resolve the exact callable and argument ownership from the pinned runtime source reached by forward_batch_generation, then execute that same binding in a CPU/import-level callsite probe. A typed proof is the only admission to a server restart.
decision_evidence.bench_safety: At 03:12Z a strict SSH reconciliation found sudo docker ps empty, the nvidia-smi compute-app query empty, and localhost:30000 health refused.
decision_evidence.why_continue: The scientific component remains wholly unconsumed, the exact checkpoint and build caches are warm, and the source-proven pre-claim gate prevents a third expensive guessed-ABI load.

requirements: Name and hash the exact pinned source files and runtime revision used by forward_batch_generation.
Record the concrete callable, receiver or owner, argument construction, return contract, and invocation location; do not rely on a class-level attribute guess.
Run a bounded CPU/import-level probe through that exact callsite or a faithful minimal construction and persist pass/fail plus traceback.
If proof fails, emit a typed preclaim terminal and do not claim the H200.

bench.reuse_contract: After the typed preclaim proof passes, atomically claim only the named ready bench and reuse its exact checkpoint, pinned image/source, and CUDA/compiler caches.

execution.first_action: Produce the source-bound preclaim proof without a GPU claim.
execution.server_replacement: After proof passes, one cached target-model server launch is authorized. Observe the child process concurrently with HTTP readiness and terminalize a fatal child exit immediately.
execution.component: Run only the still-unconsumed full-model dual-cache component comparator and persist its typed terminal.
execution.conditional_endpoint: Run the already-bound exact-c32 stock/candidate pair only if every component exactness, cache-lifecycle, CUDA-graph, and positive-net gate passes.
execution.repair_limit: No further guessed-ABI or server repair is authorized in this itinerary. A mismatch after the source proof is a typed terminal.

budgets.compute: At most 35 claimed H200 minutes at $2.45/hour after the preclaim proof passes.
budgets.wall_clock: Preclaim proof by 03:20Z, release by 03:55Z, and provider cleanup watchdog at 04:00Z.

stop_rules: Do not replay r5, infer another consumer ABI, or launch more than one server.
Do not consume more than the one incomplete component and its conditional exact-c32 pair.
Do not run exact-c32 unless the component is exact and net-positive.
Stop project processes and release the bench by 2026-07-26T03:55:00Z.
Do not train, alter checkpoint values, weaken stock-boundary gates, replay completed placement evidence, or claim quality preservation or deployability.

artifact_contract.cleanup: Stop project processes and release with reusable state preserved.
